        Quick facts

        Facts checked Nov. 3, 2026
        Motors and speed
        20 hp limit.
        Ramps and access
        Five Ohio state park ramps: Padanaram, Birches Landing, Cabin Beach, New Bowers and the campers only campground ramp. The road from Cabin Beach to Birches Marina is closed for good.
        Normal pool
        Summer pool is 1,008 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at. USGS gauge 03100500 has not reported since June 4, 2026, so this site shows no live level.
        Night rules
        State park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours. Source: ODNR, Pymatuning State Park.

        Sources: ODNR, Pymatuning State Park; ODNR, Pymatuning Lake Fishing Area; ODNR fishing map.

        How to read this
        • USGS gauge not reporting: gauge 03100500 last posted 1008.12 ft on June 4, 2026 and nothing since, so the level slot says not reporting. That old reading is not shown as current. USGS-03100500.
        • The ODNR fishing map’s depths are based on the 1,008 ft normal summer pool (3 ft contours, surveyed 2008). With no current reading, there is no pool correction to work out.
        • No public water temp gauge on the lake, so the temp slot says n/a. Nothing is estimated.
        • 20 hp limit (ODNR). Ohio side only here: an Ohio or Pennsylvania license works from a boat, but a Pennsylvania license is needed on the Pennsylvania shore or any island (ODNR 2026–27 rules).

        Tonight’s bite

        A rule of thumb guide, not a promise.

        How the bite is rated

        The Bite is this site’s own rule of thumb, not fishing science and not a forecast. It adds points from readings already on this page.

        • Barometer, the change over the last 3 hours at the lake’s NWS station. Falling slowly +2, steady +1, rising slowly 0, falling fast 0, rising fast −1. Steady means within 0.02 inHg; fast means 0.06 inHg or more.
        • Wind, tonight’s average NWS hourly speed from sunset to 2 AM (the top of each hour’s range). Under 3 mph 0, 3 to 12 mph +1, 13 to 18 mph 0, over 18 mph −2.
        • Moon, worked out on this phone. New or full moon tonight (or under 10% or over 90% lit) +1, otherwise 0.
        • Water temp, from this lake’s USGS gauge where one reports it. 55 to 80°F +1, colder than 45 or warmer than 86°F −1, anything between 0. It never makes a rating alone.
        • Thunder anywhere in tonight’s NWS forecast makes it Tough, whatever the points.

        4 points or more is Good, 2 or 3 is Fair, less is Tough. A missing reading counts 0, and with no barometer trend and no wind there is no rating.

              What this site is

              • Unofficial Ohio fishing hub with night-dock atmosphere: Hoover, Alum Creek, Buckeye Lake, O’Shaughnessy, Griggs, Indian Lake, Delaware Lake, Deer Creek Lake, Madison Lake, Knox Lake, Clear Fork Reservoir, Seneca Lake, Dillon Lake, Lake Logan, Salt Fork Lake, Burr Oak Lake, Dow Lake, Mosquito Creek Lake, Berlin Lake, West Branch Reservoir, Pymatuning Lake, Lake Milton and Leesville Lake
              • Species pages with limit reminders from the ODNR 2026–27 rules
              • One example log entry, marked Example · not ODNR / City / USGS
              Night fishing can be dangerous in storms, heat, and low visibility. Wear a life jacket when it calls for it. 20 hp limit · Pennsylvania license on the Pennsylvania shore · license ages 16+. See About.

              Park hours and notes

              Pymatuning State Park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours. 20 hp limit. The road from Cabin Beach to Birches Marina is closed for good. Cabin Beach and New Bowers ramps aren’t pinned. The east shore is Pennsylvania, with its own rules. Shoreline traced from OpenStreetMap, not for navigation.
